events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day in 1969, featuring legendary performances from artists like Jimi Hendrix, Janis Joplin, and The Who.

angles.name: Summer of Love Echoes
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, a field in upstate New York became the epicentre of a cultural revolution. From Jimi Hendrix's iconic guitar work to the sheer scale of the crowd, Woodstock 1969 was truly legendary. What's your favourite memory or track from the festival?

events.title: Elvis Presley: 49 Years On
events.blurb: The music world remembers Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Forty-nine years ago today, we lost the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley. His voice, his moves, his impact on music are still felt today. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Hynde at 75
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! The voice of The Pretenders, a true rock icon. What's your favourite Pretenders song?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star at 54
angles.copy: Our kid, Liam Gallagher, is 54 today! The iconic voice of Oasis and a true rock 'n' roll star. What's your favourite Liam moment or track?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Celebrating 64 years since Dr. No premiered and introduced 007 to the big screen. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. A true visionary whose music continues to inspire generations. What's the one Lennon track that means the most to you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy icon John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend at 87
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is unmatched. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 Years On
events.blurb: The music world remembers Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering a Champion
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, his stage presence, his legacy with Queen live on forever. What's your favourite Queen song?
